requirement.original: Refactor travel-planner infrastructure to enforce timeline.json as the SINGLE source of truth for all time/scheduling data. Remove time fields from all POI agent files (meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping). No backwards compatibility, no symbolic fixes — clean break.
requirement.clarified: Perform a clean-break refactor across schemas, scripts, and data files: (1) remove the `time` field from the four POI agent schemas and their data files, (2) remove the `time_range` shared type from poi-common.schema.json, (3) delete the _inject_time logic and all time-sync behavior from sync-agent-data.py, (4) rewrite generate-html-interactive.py to look up POI times from timeline.json by name/ref matching, (5) update plan-validate.py and save.py to not read or validate time from POI agent files. Gray areas (accommodation check_in/check_out, transportation departure_time/arrival_time) are kept as intrinsic service properties.
requirement.what: Remove time/{start,end} fields from 4 POI agent schemas + poi-common.schema.json, strip time data from 26+ data files, delete sync-agent-data.py time injection logic, rewrite HTML generator timeline lookup, update validate/save scripts
requirement.why: Eliminate dual-authority over scheduling data. Today both timeline.json and POI agent files store time ranges, leading to sync drift, circular dependencies, and schema complexity. timeline.json is the authoritative source; POI files should hold only POI-specific data.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Time/scheduling data exists redundantly in both timeline.json and POI agent files (meals, attractions, entertainment, shopping), requiring sync infrastructure that is fragile and creates drift
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The original system design placed time fields in POI agent schemas as required fields, making POI agents responsible for scheduling data they should not own. When timeline.json was introduced as the authoritative scheduling source, sync-agent-data.py was added as a band-aid to copy times from timeline into POI files rather than removing time from POI files
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural debt across multiple historical commits
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: POI schemas originally included time for convenience — agents could describe a complete activity in one place. Timeline was added later as a higher-level scheduling mechanism without cleaning up the now-redundant time fields in POI schemas.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Dual authority creates: (1) drift when timeline is updated but sync is not run, (2) circular dependency where sync reads timeline to write POI files, (3) schema complexity from time_range type used across all POI schemas, (4) HTML generator reading stale POI times instead of authoritative timeline times
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Architectural debt present since initial schema design; sync-agent-data.py added as workaround; now being eliminated with clean break

context.codebase_state: 26 data files across 8 trip directories contain time fields in POI items. 3 accommodation.json files have injected time fields. schemas use additionalProperties: false on all 4 POI item types.

development_approach.strategy: Execute in 4 phases to prevent breakage at each stage: (1) Schema surgery — remove time from 4 POI schemas and poi-common.schema.json, update poi-data-schema.md; (2) Script surgery — delete _inject_time and all sync time logic, update generate-html-interactive.py to read from timeline, update plan-validate.py and save.py; (3) Data cleanup — strip time fields from all 26 POI data files and 3 accommodation files; (4) Verification — run plan-validate.py to confirm zero HIGH issues, run HTML generator to confirm time displays correctly.
